tasks.short: Plan and prepare food for household social events.

steps.what: Discuss actual event, guest numbers, preferences and dietary restrictions with the household
inputs: actual household event needs and guest restrictions

steps.what: Choose event dishes and verify actual ingredient specifications against guest restrictions
outputs: cook-chosen recipes with verified ingredients and portions

steps.what: Scale selected recipe quantities and assemble event preparation sheets using native recipe tools
inputs: cook-chosen recipes with verified ingredients and portions
outputs: checked event quantity and preparation sheets

steps.what: Finalize and approve complete event menu, preparation plan and exact household recipient
inputs: checked event quantity and preparation sheets
cook-chosen recipes with verified ingredients and portions
outputs: approved final event menu and preparation plan with exact household recipient

steps.what: Send approved final event menu to the approved household recipient
inputs: approved final event menu and preparation plan with exact household recipient

steps.what: Prepare and cook actual event meals, checking ingredients, taste and food handling
inputs: approved final event menu and preparation plan with exact household recipient
outputs: actual prepared meals and cooking observations

steps.what: Write and approve actual event recipe adjustments, quantities and food-handling observations
inputs: actual prepared meals and cooking observations
outputs: approved final actual event cooking note

steps.what: Save approved actual event cooking note
inputs: approved final actual event cooking note

tasks.design: Configure portion scaling and preparation-sheet templates in {RECIPE_TOOL}. The cook captures actual guest requirements, chooses dishes and checks actual ingredient labels. Native quantities are checked before the complete final event menu is approved and separately sent. Physical cooking and actual event note capture stay full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated recipe scaling and preparation-sheet assembly for the chosen event menu.
tasks.enabler_now: Native recipe quantities and ingredient-linked records.
tasks.still_hard: Guest preferences, actual restrictions, taste and practical event cooking.
tasks.human_edge: Adjusting real food for the actual household and kitchen.
tasks.altitude: Less quantity preparation around full household cooking work.

evidence.claim: Recipe systems link ingredient quantities and ingredient information; household event-sheet configuration is proposed, with no measured time baseline.

assumptions: Shares are provisional and conditional on actual residual scaling after existing recipe tools. Existing calculations earn no new saving.

s1 counts actual guest count and restrictions capture; s2 counts recipe selection and actual label verification. Native recipe_id, ingredient_id, quantity, yield and cook-selected portions supply s3. Its retained 7.5 hours check quantities, cooking scale and source completeness; unavailable recipes stay manual.

No model makes the final allergen claim or infers kitchen cross-contact safety. Cooking and actual note writing remain full. Approvals follow complete final menu or actual note; changes void them. Same-system save and send retain full effort; minimum shares are provisional granularity.
research_questions: Which event portion and preparation sheets still need repeated manual assembly?

incremental.description: Maintain verified recipe quantities and preparation templates

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final event menu and exact household recipient
s7 complete final actual event cooking note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15 times 50% = 7.5 less 0.5 upkeep = 7. Low halves preparation benefit: 3.75 less 0.5 = 3.25; provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Create and explore new cuisines through actual cooking.

steps.what: Retrieve and compare actual cuisine references and previously recorded recipe trials
inputs: actual cookbooks, recipe references and existing trial notes

steps.what: Create cuisine ideas and explore actual ingredients, cooking techniques and flavor combinations
outputs: actual cooked cuisine trials and taste observations

steps.what: Write and approve actual cuisine trial recipes, taste findings and next refinements
inputs: actual cooked cuisine trials and taste observations
outputs: approved final actual cuisine trial record

steps.what: Save approved actual cuisine trial record
inputs: approved final actual cuisine trial record

tasks.design: Configure cuisine, technique and source tags in the existing {RECIPE_LIBRARY}. Retrieve actual reference recipes and previous trial notes without repeatedly browsing separate folders. Creative cooking, tasting and actual trial recording remain full work. The complete final actual trial record is approved before its separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly locating recipe precedents and actual trial notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Native recipe-library filters and source links.
tasks.still_hard: Creating appealing new flavors and understanding actual cooking results.
tasks.human_edge: Taste, texture and cultural understanding of the cuisine.
tasks.altitude: Less reference retrieval before full creative cuisine exploration.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: recipe libraries can filter recorded cuisines, techniques and source references; the cook’s current tools must be checked.

assumptions: Shares are provisional; count only actual residual reference browsing after native recipe tools. Existing search runtime earns no saving.

Actual reference records supply recipe_id, cuisine, technique and source. Existing trial notes are written by the cook; new actual trial capture is counted in full s3. s1 retains 9 hours checking reference relevance and source accuracy; untagged material remains manual.

No machine invents successful tasting outcomes. All creative cooking and actual recipe writing stay full effort. Approval follows the complete final actual record; changes void it. Same-system save earns no saving.
research_questions: Which actual cuisine and trial references remain hard to locate?

incremental.description: Maintain cuisine and technique reference tags

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete final actual cuisine trial record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15 times 40% = 6 less 0.5 upkeep = 5.5. Low halves retrieval benefit: 3 less 0.5 = 2.5; provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Household cooks retain menu choice, guest understanding, physical cooking and taste while recipe preparation decreases.
reach: Household preferences and actual ingredient evidence remain essential inputs.
role.ambitious_version: Chosen menus and actual cuisine trials remain traceable to verified ingredients and actual cooking observations.
